name: Ring of the Fallen
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a saint’s ring. However, the ring does not cure but instead causes damage, allowing the wearer to use inflict light wounds 3/day.

Additionally, if the wearer is reduced to less than zero hit points, the ring emits a burst of negative energy similar to a cleric‘s channel energy ability, causing all living creatures, including the wearer, within a 30 foot radius 5d8+9 points of damage and healing all undead creatures in range the same amount.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it. This destroys the ring and there is a 50% chance of the ring erupting with a burst of negative energy as outlined above.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items saint’s ring

Identification DC 34
False Identification DC 24
